newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Long Australian bonds underperform dlr bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Long Australian bonds underperform dlr bloc.

text.p: Long-dated Australian bonds underperformed against the dollar bloc, although short-end differentials were relatively stable after Wednesday's cut in domestic interest rates.
This also saw the local yield curve steepen again with the three/10-year cash spread brushing 100 basis points at one stage, some 30 basis points up in the space of two days.
Offshore selling of the local market in tandem with a plunge in U.S. Treasuries saw long spreads widen and break back over 100 basis points on the 10-year Australian/U.S. spread.
Canadian and New Zealand bonds also took their leads from the U.S.
